Issue 1

⚓ Continued Tanker Strikes and Navigation Threats in the Strait of Hormuz and UAE Waters

Key summary
  • UKMTO reported a tanker-related incident in the Strait of Hormuz, with crew status etc. still being confirmed; at the same time, operator Adnoc announced a vessel strike in UAE waters.
  • The IRGC Navy claimed that the US military is reluctant to approach the Strait of Hormuz and is luring tankers into a 'wall of fire,' suggesting continued tension in the strait, which caused international oil prices (Brent) to rebound from a 2-month low.
  • The UAE decided to sell, on behalf of others, Saudi crude oil loaded on a VLCC that was struck and leaked oil off its coast.

Issue 2

🔥 Fire Breaks Out at Iran's South Pars Gas Field

Key summary
  • A fire broke out on a platform at Iran's South Pars gas field and is being extinguished and handled, with a gas leak or operational accident cited as a possible cause (citing Iran's Fars news agency).
  • South Pars is the world's largest offshore gas field, and the accident at Iran's facility (platform) requires monitoring as a regional gas production and safety risk.
🇶🇦 Qatar (local)
Fire contained on platform in Iran’s South Pars gas fieldAl Jazeera · 11/11 02:38
Issue 3

🇵🇱 Poland's Orlen Terminates Long-Term LNG Contract with QatarEnergy

Key summary
  • Poland's state-owned energy company Orlen terminated its long-term LNG supply contract with QatarEnergy, citing delivery failure due to the war.
  • Amid growing instability in Europe's LNG supply chain, European winter gas reserves have fallen to their lowest level since records began in 2011, raising concerns over a surge in heating costs.
  • This issue could damage the reliability of QatarEnergy's LNG supply to Europe and the stability of its contracts, potentially affecting Qatar's strategy of diversifying energy exports and securing alternative demand destinations.

Issue 4

🇺🇸🇮🇷 US-Iran War Situation Continues — Hegseth Impeachment Blocked, Alleged Trump-Netanyahu Conflict

Key summary
  • The US House of Representatives voted 211 in favor to reject the impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth (blocking committee referral), with 11 Democrats absent while Republicans unified in a single front; Vice President JD Vance also reversed his earlier criticism of the Iran war, calling the impeachment a 'political show' and defending Hegseth.
  • Reports emerged that President Trump and Prime Minister Netanyahu had a heated argument with raised voices in a recent phone call over whether to resume military operations against Iran, exposing a strategic rift between the US and Israel regarding Iran.
  • US prosecutors filed additional charges against three Iran-linked operatives for allegedly plotting an attack on the RAF Fairford air base in the UK, with suspicions raised that an inmate at a federal prison in New York directed the plot.

Issue 5

🇮🇷 Iran Strengthens Wartime Posture, Pushes Back Against US Pressure

Key summary
  • Iran opened its first military training camp for female civilians in Tehran, citing preparation against a possible US ground attack, with participants undergoing rope and zipline training as well as pistol and rifle handling training.
  • The commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force stated at an event unveiling a new missile city that Iran is ready to respond to all threats, both within and outside the region.
  • Iran's Foreign Ministry officially requested that the UN and IAEA condemn the US for offering a bounty (up to $20 million) for information on its nuclear scientists.

🕊️ Gaza Situation — Continued Israeli Airstrikes, Deepening Humanitarian Crisis

Key summary
  • Israeli airstrikes killed at least 8 Palestinians in Gaza, including a father and son; Gaza's media office claimed that Israel has dropped 100,000 tons of explosives during the war, completely destroying 2,200 households.
  • Winter rainstorms and flooding have added further suffering for Gaza residents; Israel maintains that winter supplies are being allowed in, but reconstruction is conditional on Hamas's disarmament, while Qatar's Minister of Labor noted that the Palestinian situation is deepening both the humanitarian and economic crisis.

This page automatically collects and summarizes public news coverage and material from relevant institutions across Qatar, Iran, other major countries and Korea. News is gathered by querying Google News RSS feeds, Naver News search, and outlet RSS (Al Jazeera, BBC, etc.) with keywords such as Qatar, the Middle East and energy; in-depth reports are collected directly from the publication boards and RSS of domestic and international research institutes, international organizations and consultancies (supplemented by news search targeting those publishers), keeping only analyses and reports on the Middle East situation, the Iran war and their industrial, supply-chain and energy repercussions. The report list accumulates items published since the war's outbreak (2026-02-28), split into domestic and overseas and ordered by publication date (newest first). Collection and summarization rely on each outlet's publicly available headline and snippet; for subscription or paywalled outlets, the full article can be opened through the provided source link only after the reader signs in or subscribes to that outlet directly. The collected articles are automatically clustered and summarized by issue, and translated into English and Arabic, by Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 5) AI. The whole process runs and publishes automatically twice a day (07:00 and 15:30 Qatar time) via GitHub Actions. The Qatar government activity section separately curates only official statements, announcements and actions on the war and regional situation by Qatar government and state entities — the Emir, the Prime Minister, the ministries of Foreign Affairs, Defense and Interior, the Government Communications Office (GCO), QatarEnergy and the state news agency (QNA). Owing to automated collection some articles or reports may be missed, so please re-verify important issues against the original sources and further searches.
- Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Qatar, Commercial Section · KOTRA Doha
